title: 台北 101
summary: 用 24 步拆解超高層建築的核心、外伸桁架、基礎、風振控制與營運介面，將外觀地標轉成可解釋的工程系統。
summaryEn: Use 24 steps to unpack the core, outriggers, foundations, wind-motion control and operating interfaces of a supertall building.
scope: 以公開一次資料為背景的原創工程判讀課程；每步在紙上或數位示意模型中完成。自設數值、構形與工序不得當成原工程的設計、施工、設備操作或驗收程序。
scopeEn: Original engineering interpretation exercises grounded in public primary sources. Complete each step on paper or in a schematic digital model. Invented values, geometry and sequences are not the original project’s design, construction, operating or acceptance procedures.

stages.title: 需求、場址與荷載
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「需求、場址與荷載」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on requirements, site and loads, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 分清高度與使用需求
steps.titleEn: Separate height from functional requirements
steps.objective: 把地標高度轉成結構與使用性能問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Translate landmark height into structural and service-performance questions.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫辦公、機械及觀景用途區；2. 分列承載、舒適與維護需求；3. 為每類寫一種需要的證據。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch office, mechanical and observation zones; 2. separate capacity, comfort and maintenance needs; 3. name evidence for each.
steps.observation: 足夠承載能力不會自動保證高樓使用者感到舒適。
steps.observationEn: Adequate load capacity does not automatically establish occupant comfort.
steps.failure: 只以總高度判定建築性能是否良好。
steps.failureEn: Assess building performance from total height alone.
steps.check: 提交三類需求和對應證據矩陣。
steps.checkEn: Submit a matrix of three requirement classes and their evidence.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 極限承載與日常服務性能回答不同問題，風中加速度常與使用感受有關。
knowledge.textEn: Ultimate capacity and everyday serviceability answer different questions; wind acceleration can matter to occupants.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 建築高度是幾何背景，不是風、地震或舒適性能的直接評分。
knowledge.textEn: Building height is geometric context, not a direct wind, seismic or comfort score.

quiz.question: 審查「分清高度與使用需求」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate height from functional requirements”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 足夠承載能力不會自動保證高樓使用者感到舒適。
只以總高度判定建築性能是否良好。
一棟樓有足夠承載能力就不會產生令人不適的加速度。
optionsEn: Adequate load capacity does not automatically establish occupant comfort.
Assess building performance from total height alone.
Adequate capacity guarantees absence of uncomfortable acceleration.
quiz.explanation: 極限承載與日常服務性能回答不同問題，風中加速度常與使用感受有關。 建築高度是幾何背景，不是風、地震或舒適性能的直接評分。
quiz.explanationEn: Ultimate capacity and everyday serviceability answer different questions; wind acceleration can matter to occupants. Building height is geometric context, not a direct wind, seismic or comfort score.

steps.title: 標記都市場址介面
steps.titleEn: Map urban-site interfaces
steps.objective: 理解基地邊界以外仍有工程依賴。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand dependencies beyond the property boundary.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫基地、周邊道路及鄰房；2. 標示地下水與管線資料空白；3. 區分公開地址、假設範圍與待調查範圍。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch site, roads and neighboring buildings; 2. mark gaps in groundwater and utility knowledge; 3. distinguish the public address, assumptions and investigation scope.
steps.observation: 精確街址不能取代地下管線及地層調查。
steps.observationEn: A precise street address does not replace utility and ground investigation.
steps.failure: Google 地圖看到建築輪廓便可推知地下基礎範圍。
steps.failureEn: A visible building outline on Google Maps establishes its underground foundation extent.
steps.check: 輸出含三個地下未知項的基地圖。
steps.checkEn: Produce a site plan with three underground unknowns.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 深基礎與地下室的變形或水位影響可能跨越地籍邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Deep-foundation and basement deformation or water effects can extend beyond cadastral boundaries.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 公開地圖適合建立背景與方位，不能當作現地測量控制資料。
knowledge.textEn: Public maps establish context and orientation, not field survey control.

quiz.question: 審查「標記都市場址介面」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Map urban-site interfaces”, which interpretation is justified?
options: Google 地圖看到建築輪廓便可推知地下基礎範圍。
精確街址不能取代地下管線及地層調查。
地下室與基礎的影響必然止於地籍邊界。
optionsEn: A visible building outline on Google Maps establishes its underground foundation extent.
A precise street address does not replace utility and ground investigation.
Basement and foundation effects necessarily stop at cadastral boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 深基礎與地下室的變形或水位影響可能跨越地籍邊界。 公開地圖適合建立背景與方位，不能當作現地測量控制資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Deep-foundation and basement deformation or water effects can extend beyond cadastral boundaries. Public maps establish context and orientation, not field survey control.

steps.title: 區分重力與水平力路徑
steps.titleEn: Separate gravity and lateral force paths
steps.objective: 把樓板、核心與周邊柱接成不同力路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect floors, core and perimeter columns through distinct force paths.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫一個概念標準層；2. 以兩色分別追蹤重力及水平力；3. 在基礎處關閉兩條反力路徑。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a conceptual typical floor; 2. trace gravity and lateral forces in two colors; 3. close both reaction paths at foundations.
steps.observation: 同一樓板可以同時承受重力並傳遞平面內水平作用。
steps.observationEn: A floor can support gravity and transmit in-plane lateral action simultaneously.
steps.failure: 重力傳到柱子後就不需要考慮樓板的水平傳力。
steps.failureEn: Once gravity reaches columns, floor-level lateral transfer can be ignored.
steps.check: 提交包含樓板平面內作用的雙色受力圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide a two-color force map including floor in-plane action.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 樓板作為水平傳力構件時需要足夠連接；畫成剛性平面是一種模型假設。
knowledge.textEn: Floors require connections to transfer lateral action; drawing a rigid diaphragm is a modeling assumption.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 核心、周邊框架與基礎的分工取決於整體配置，不能從立面照片唯一推導。
knowledge.textEn: The roles of core, perimeter framing and foundations depend on the system and cannot be uniquely inferred from a façade photo.

quiz.question: 審查「區分重力與水平力路徑」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate gravity and lateral force paths”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 重力傳到柱子後就不需要考慮樓板的水平傳力。
樓板的平面內作用與其連接條件完全無關。
同一樓板可以同時承受重力並傳遞平面內水平作用。
optionsEn: Once gravity reaches columns, floor-level lateral transfer can be ignored.
In-plane floor action is entirely independent of connections.
A floor can support gravity and transmit in-plane lateral action simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 樓板作為水平傳力構件時需要足夠連接；畫成剛性平面是一種模型假設。 核心、周邊框架與基礎的分工取決於整體配置，不能從立面照片唯一推導。
quiz.explanationEn: Floors require connections to transfer lateral action; drawing a rigid diaphragm is a modeling assumption. The roles of core, perimeter framing and foundations depend on the system and cannot be uniquely inferred from a façade photo.

steps.title: 拆出質量、剛度與阻尼
steps.titleEn: Separate mass, stiffness and damping
steps.objective: 建立高樓振動的最小概念模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a minimal conceptual model of tall-building motion.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫單自由度質量彈簧模型；2. 分別改變一個無量綱參數；3. 比較頻率及衰減形狀。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a one-degree-of-freedom mass-spring model; 2. change one dimensionless parameter at a time; 3. compare frequency and decay shape.
steps.observation: 增加質量與增加剛度通常對頻率產生不同方向的影響。
steps.observationEn: Increasing mass and increasing stiffness generally shift frequency in different directions.
steps.failure: 只看振幅較小便確定質量、剛度與阻尼都提高。
steps.failureEn: A smaller amplitude proves that mass, stiffness and damping all increased.
steps.check: 繳交三個單參數變更的對照圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide three comparisons changing one parameter at a time.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 理想線性振子頻率與剛度和質量的比值有關，阻尼控制能量消散。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal linear-oscillator frequency depends on stiffness relative to mass; damping governs dissipation.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 單自由度模型省略高階與扭轉模態，只適合說明機理。
knowledge.textEn: A one-degree model omits higher and torsional modes and is suitable only for explaining mechanisms.

quiz.question: 審查「拆出質量、剛度與阻尼」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate mass, stiffness and damping”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 增加質量與增加剛度通常對頻率產生不同方向的影響。
只看振幅較小便確定質量、剛度與阻尼都提高。
剛度加倍一定使理想振子的頻率加倍。
optionsEn: Increasing mass and increasing stiffness generally shift frequency in different directions.
A smaller amplitude proves that mass, stiffness and damping all increased.
Doubling stiffness necessarily doubles ideal oscillator frequency.
quiz.explanation: 理想線性振子頻率與剛度和質量的比值有關，阻尼控制能量消散。 單自由度模型省略高階與扭轉模態，只適合說明機理。
quiz.explanationEn: Ideal linear-oscillator frequency depends on stiffness relative to mass; damping governs dissipation. A one-degree model omits higher and torsional modes and is suitable only for explaining mechanisms.

steps.title: 比較風與地震輸入
steps.titleEn: Compare wind and earthquake inputs
steps.objective: 辨認外力激振與基底運動的差別。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish applied-force excitation from base motion.
steps.instruction: 1. 在樓身畫風作用分布；2. 在基礎畫假想地盤移動；3. 列出兩情境不同的輸入與輸出量。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw wind actions along the tower; 2. draw hypothetical ground movement at the base; 3. list distinct inputs and outputs for both cases.
steps.observation: 風與地震都能引起振動，但輸入位置與時間特徵不同。
steps.observationEn: Wind and earthquakes both induce motion but differ in input location and time characteristics.
steps.failure: 兩者最大位移相同就代表每層受力及使用感受相同。
steps.failureEn: Equal peak displacement implies equal story forces and occupant experience.
steps.check: 提交兩個輸入—系統—觀察量的方塊圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit two input–system–observation diagrams.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 外力與基底運動使用不同邊界描述；比較時必須先對齊量的定義。
knowledge.textEn: Applied forces and base motion use different boundary descriptions; comparisons require aligned definitions.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本練習不把任一自設時程當成台北 101 的設計地震或風場。
knowledge.textEn: No synthetic time history in this exercise is a Taipei 101 design earthquake or wind field.

quiz.question: 審查「比較風與地震輸入」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare wind and earthquake inputs”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 兩者最大位移相同就代表每層受力及使用感受相同。
風與地震都能引起振動，但輸入位置與時間特徵不同。
地震輸入只能畫成樓頂的一個靜態水平力。
optionsEn: Equal peak displacement implies equal story forces and occupant experience.
Wind and earthquakes both induce motion but differ in input location and time characteristics.
Earthquake input can only be represented by one static roof force.
quiz.explanation: 外力與基底運動使用不同邊界描述；比較時必須先對齊量的定義。 本練習不把任一自設時程當成台北 101 的設計地震或風場。
quiz.explanationEn: Applied forces and base motion use different boundary descriptions; comparisons require aligned definitions. No synthetic time history in this exercise is a Taipei 101 design earthquake or wind field.

steps.title: 審查地基與結構需求
steps.titleEn: Review ground and structural requirements
steps.objective: 把上部結構反力連接到基礎證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect superstructure reactions to foundation evidence.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫壓力、拔力及水平反力箭頭；2. 對應樁、承台及地層概念區；3. 分開承載與沉陷兩類問題。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw compression, uplift and horizontal reactions; 2. connect them to conceptual piles, caps and strata; 3. separate capacity from settlement questions.
steps.observation: 足夠承載與可接受差異沉陷是兩個不同檢查。
steps.observationEn: Adequate capacity and acceptable differential settlement are separate checks.
steps.failure: 樁數足夠就能忽略群樁及沉陷差異。
steps.failureEn: A sufficient pile count makes group effects and differential settlement irrelevant.
steps.check: 輸出一張反力對證據需求的配對表。
steps.checkEn: Produce a reaction-to-evidence matching table.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 基礎設計需處理荷載分配與變形相容；不能只將總重除以樁數。
knowledge.textEn: Foundation design addresses load distribution and deformation compatibility, not simply total weight divided by pile count.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 官方基礎概要提供系統背景，不提供可用於新基地的承載設計值。
knowledge.textEn: The owner’s foundation overview supplies system context, not bearing design values for another site.

quiz.question: 審查「審查地基與結構需求」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review ground and structural requirements”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 樁數足夠就能忽略群樁及沉陷差異。
總重除以樁數即可完整預測每根樁的受力與沉陷。
足夠承載與可接受差異沉陷是兩個不同檢查。
optionsEn: A sufficient pile count makes group effects and differential settlement irrelevant.
Total weight divided by pile count fully predicts each pile’s load and settlement.
Adequate capacity and acceptable differential settlement are separate checks.
quiz.explanation: 基礎設計需處理荷載分配與變形相容；不能只將總重除以樁數。 官方基礎概要提供系統背景，不提供可用於新基地的承載設計值。
quiz.explanationEn: Foundation design addresses load distribution and deformation compatibility, not simply total weight divided by pile count. The owner’s foundation overview supplies system context, not bearing design values for another site.

stages.title: 核心、外伸桁架與介面
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「核心、外伸桁架與介面」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on core, outriggers and interfaces, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 辨認斜撐核心系統
steps.titleEn: Identify the braced core
steps.objective: 將核心視為具有連接與變形的結構。
steps.objectiveEn: Treat the core as a structure with connections and deformation.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫核心框架與假想斜撐；2. 標記軸力及層間側移；3. 比較連接完整與鬆開的概念模型。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch core framing and conceptual braces; 2. mark axial forces and story drift; 3. compare connected and released idealized models.
steps.observation: 核心的側向作用依賴構件與連接共同形成傳力系統。
steps.observationEn: Core lateral action depends on members and connections forming a continuous system.
steps.failure: 只要核心外框封閉就一定具有相同剛度。
steps.failureEn: Any closed core outline necessarily has identical stiffness.
steps.check: 提供構件、連接與層間位移三種標記。
steps.checkEn: Provide member, connection and story-drift annotations.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 斜撐利用軸向作用參與側向抵抗，但連接假設會改變整體變形。
knowledge.textEn: Braces participate through axial action, while connection assumptions affect overall deformation.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 示意模型不還原實樓所有斜撐位置，細節須由工程圖及專業分析確認。
knowledge.textEn: The schematic does not reproduce every real brace location; details require engineering drawings and analysis.

quiz.question: 審查「辨認斜撐核心系統」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Identify the braced core”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 核心的側向作用依賴構件與連接共同形成傳力系統。
只要核心外框封閉就一定具有相同剛度。
核心構件只要存在，連接方式就不影響變形。
optionsEn: Core lateral action depends on members and connections forming a continuous system.
Any closed core outline necessarily has identical stiffness.
Core-member presence makes connection details irrelevant to deformation.
quiz.explanation: 斜撐利用軸向作用參與側向抵抗，但連接假設會改變整體變形。 示意模型不還原實樓所有斜撐位置，細節須由工程圖及專業分析確認。
quiz.explanationEn: Braces participate through axial action, while connection assumptions affect overall deformation. The schematic does not reproduce every real brace location; details require engineering drawings and analysis.

steps.title: 理解外伸桁架如何連接周邊柱
steps.titleEn: Understand outrigger-to-perimeter coupling
steps.objective: 追蹤核心傾轉與周邊軸力的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Trace the relationship between core rotation and perimeter axial forces.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫核心、外伸桁架及兩側柱；2. 施加小幅概念側移；3. 標記兩側柱軸力增減及基礎反力。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a core, outrigger and two perimeter columns; 2. apply a small conceptual sway; 3. mark changes in column axial forces and foundation reactions.
steps.observation: 外伸桁架透過周邊柱的軸向作用協助抵抗核心傾轉。
steps.observationEn: An outrigger engages perimeter-column axial action to help resist core rotation.
steps.failure: 外伸桁架只承受自重，不影響周邊柱的受力。
steps.failureEn: An outrigger carries only its own weight and does not affect perimeter-column forces.
steps.check: 提交可追蹤到基礎的外伸桁架力路徑。
steps.checkEn: Submit an outrigger force path traceable to foundations.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 增加有效抵抗力臂可以改變抗傾覆分工，但必須包含連接與基礎。
knowledge.textEn: Engaging a wider resisting lever arm changes overturning resistance but must include connections and foundations.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 台北 101 的多層外伸系統有特定配置；本模型只是解釋作用原理。
knowledge.textEn: Taipei 101 has a specific multi-outrigger layout; this model only explains the mechanism.

quiz.question: 審查「理解外伸桁架如何連接周邊柱」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Understand outrigger-to-perimeter coupling”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 外伸桁架只承受自重，不影響周邊柱的受力。
外伸桁架透過周邊柱的軸向作用協助抵抗核心傾轉。
外伸桁架不需要把作用追蹤到基礎。
optionsEn: An outrigger carries only its own weight and does not affect perimeter-column forces.
An outrigger engages perimeter-column axial action to help resist core rotation.
Outrigger action need not be traced to foundations.
quiz.explanation: 增加有效抵抗力臂可以改變抗傾覆分工，但必須包含連接與基礎。 台北 101 的多層外伸系統有特定配置；本模型只是解釋作用原理。
quiz.explanationEn: Engaging a wider resisting lever arm changes overturning resistance but must include connections and foundations. Taipei 101 has a specific multi-outrigger layout; this model only explains the mechanism.

steps.title: 核對機械層的多系統介面
steps.titleEn: Audit mechanical-floor interfaces
steps.objective: 辨識設備、結構與維修空間的衝突。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify conflicts among equipment, structure and maintenance space.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫一層概念機械層；2. 疊放桁架、管線及維修通道；3. 為每個相交處建立介面問題卡。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a conceptual mechanical floor; 2. overlay trusses, services and maintenance routes; 3. create an interface issue card at each conflict.
steps.observation: 管線能穿過圖面空白不代表現場具有維修及結構許可空間。
steps.observationEn: A service passing through blank drawing space does not establish maintenance clearance or structural permission.
steps.failure: 只檢查設備外框不相交就能完成機械層協調。
steps.failureEn: Nonintersecting equipment outlines alone complete mechanical-floor coordination.
steps.check: 提交至少三個介面衝突及其責任資料欄。
steps.checkEn: Submit at least three interface conflicts with responsible-data fields.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 結構及設備系統共用空間，維護可達性與施工順序也是介面條件。
knowledge.textEn: Structure and services share space; maintenance access and construction sequence are interface conditions too.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 數位碰撞檢查能找幾何衝突，但不能自行批准結構開孔。
knowledge.textEn: Digital clash detection finds geometric conflicts but cannot authorize structural penetrations.

quiz.question: 審查「核對機械層的多系統介面」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Audit mechanical-floor interfaces”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 只檢查設備外框不相交就能完成機械層協調。
維修人員所需空間不是設備與結構協調的一部分。
管線能穿過圖面空白不代表現場具有維修及結構許可空間。
optionsEn: Nonintersecting equipment outlines alone complete mechanical-floor coordination.
Maintenance access is outside structural-equipment coordination.
A service passing through blank drawing space does not establish maintenance clearance or structural permission.
quiz.explanation: 結構及設備系統共用空間，維護可達性與施工順序也是介面條件。 數位碰撞檢查能找幾何衝突，但不能自行批准結構開孔。
quiz.explanationEn: Structure and services share space; maintenance access and construction sequence are interface conditions too. Digital clash detection finds geometric conflicts but cannot authorize structural penetrations.

steps.title: 比較周邊框架與核心分工
steps.titleEn: Compare perimeter-frame and core roles
steps.objective: 避免將所有水平荷載只分配給核心。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid assigning every lateral action to the core alone.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫核心及周邊兩個平行子系統；2. 分別設定相對軟硬的示意值；3. 比較分力與變形相容條件。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw core and perimeter as parallel subsystems; 2. assign illustrative relative stiffnesses; 3. compare load sharing and deformation compatibility.
steps.observation: 相連子系統的相對剛度會影響分力，而非只看構件數量。
steps.observationEn: Relative stiffness of connected subsystems affects force sharing, not merely member count.
steps.failure: 核心較粗就能將周邊框架在模型中全部刪除。
steps.failureEn: A large core justifies deleting all perimeter framing from the model.
steps.check: 輸出兩種剛度比例下的定性分力圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide qualitative force-sharing diagrams for two stiffness ratios.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 相容變形與力平衡必須同時滿足；各系統不能獨立任意分配荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Deformation compatibility and force equilibrium must hold together; loads cannot be assigned arbitrarily to isolated systems.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 設計者的系統概要可指引模型邊界，但不提供完整分析矩陣。
knowledge.textEn: The designer’s system overview guides model boundaries but does not supply a full analysis matrix.

quiz.question: 審查「比較周邊框架與核心分工」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare perimeter-frame and core roles”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 相連子系統的相對剛度會影響分力，而非只看構件數量。
核心較粗就能將周邊框架在模型中全部刪除。
周邊框架與核心可以各自任意分配水平荷載。
optionsEn: Relative stiffness of connected subsystems affects force sharing, not merely member count.
A large core justifies deleting all perimeter framing from the model.
Perimeter frames and core can allocate lateral loads arbitrarily and independently.
quiz.explanation: 相容變形與力平衡必須同時滿足；各系統不能獨立任意分配荷載。 設計者的系統概要可指引模型邊界，但不提供完整分析矩陣。
quiz.explanationEn: Deformation compatibility and force equilibrium must hold together; loads cannot be assigned arbitrarily to isolated systems. The designer’s system overview guides model boundaries but does not supply a full analysis matrix.

steps.title: 檢查樓板開口的傳力繞道
steps.titleEn: Review load paths around floor openings
steps.objective: 理解管道及電梯開口對傳力的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how service and elevator openings affect force transfer.
steps.instruction: 1. 在概念樓板畫兩個開口；2. 繪出繞過開口的平面內力路徑；3. 標記需要連接細節的邊緣。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw two openings in a conceptual floor; 2. trace in-plane force paths around them; 3. identify edges needing connection details.
steps.observation: 局部開口可能改變傳力集中位置，不能只扣除面積。
steps.observationEn: An opening can change force concentration locations rather than simply subtract area.
steps.failure: 樓板總面積差不多便代表開口位置不重要。
steps.failureEn: Similar total floor area makes opening location irrelevant.
steps.check: 提交含邊緣與連接需求的樓板力路徑圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit a floor force-path map with edge and connection needs.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 水平傳力須繞過不連續處，幾何與連接決定可用路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Lateral force transfer must bypass discontinuities; geometry and connections determine available paths.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本步示意開口是教學自設，不是台北 101 的實際樓層平面。
knowledge.textEn: Openings in this exercise are invented teaching geometry, not an actual Taipei 101 floor plan.

quiz.question: 審查「檢查樓板開口的傳力繞道」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review load paths around floor openings”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 樓板總面積差不多便代表開口位置不重要。
局部開口可能改變傳力集中位置，不能只扣除面積。
相同開口總面積保證相同的局部傳力路徑。
optionsEn: Similar total floor area makes opening location irrelevant.
An opening can change force concentration locations rather than simply subtract area.
Equal total opening area guarantees identical local force paths.
quiz.explanation: 水平傳力須繞過不連續處，幾何與連接決定可用路徑。 本步示意開口是教學自設，不是台北 101 的實際樓層平面。
quiz.explanationEn: Lateral force transfer must bypass discontinuities; geometry and connections determine available paths. Openings in this exercise are invented teaching geometry, not an actual Taipei 101 floor plan.

steps.title: 用介面矩陣完成結構複核
steps.titleEn: Complete a structural-interface review
steps.objective: 讓核心、桁架、樓板與基礎使用一致假設。
steps.objectiveEn: Align assumptions across core, outriggers, floors and foundations.
steps.instruction: 1. 列出四類子系統；2. 每對介面填入力、位移及資料版本；3. 將一個矛盾假設回溯到受影響的步驟。
steps.instructionEn: 1. List four subsystem classes; 2. record forces, movements and data versions at each interface; 3. trace one inconsistent assumption to affected steps.
steps.observation: 單一子系統看似合理仍可能與相鄰系統的邊界不一致。
steps.observationEn: A plausible subsystem may still conflict with adjacent boundary assumptions.
steps.failure: 各張圖都沒有畫錯元件就表示整體模型一定相容。
steps.failureEn: Correctly drawn components on every sheet guarantee global compatibility.
steps.check: 繳交一份包含修訂紀錄的四系統矩陣。
steps.checkEn: Provide a four-system matrix with a revision record.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 工程介面需要雙方共享相同的力與位移定義，否則資料無法直接串接。
knowledge.textEn: Engineering interfaces require shared force and movement definitions for usable data exchange.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 複核應記錄哪些下游結論需要重做，不能只修改衝突那一張圖。
knowledge.textEn: Review records should identify downstream conclusions needing revision, not only the conflicting drawing.

quiz.question: 審查「用介面矩陣完成結構複核」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Complete a structural-interface review”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 各張圖都沒有畫錯元件就表示整體模型一定相容。
不同專業採用不同位移定義不影響介面資料交換。
單一子系統看似合理仍可能與相鄰系統的邊界不一致。
optionsEn: Correctly drawn components on every sheet guarantee global compatibility.
Different displacement definitions do not affect interface data exchange.
A plausible subsystem may still conflict with adjacent boundary assumptions.
quiz.explanation: 工程介面需要雙方共享相同的力與位移定義，否則資料無法直接串接。 複核應記錄哪些下游結論需要重做，不能只修改衝突那一張圖。
quiz.explanationEn: Engineering interfaces require shared force and movement definitions for usable data exchange. Review records should identify downstream conclusions needing revision, not only the conflicting drawing.

stages.title: 風振、量測與機電
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「風振、量測與機電」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on wind motion, measurement and services, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 畫出調諧質量阻尼器雙系統
steps.titleEn: Draw a tuned-mass-damper model
steps.objective: 區分建築本體與輔助質量的相對運動。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish building motion from auxiliary-mass relative motion.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫建築與懸吊質量兩個自由度；2. 標示兩者位移及相對位移；3. 畫出阻尼作用連接的位置。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw building and suspended-mass degrees of freedom; 2. mark both displacements and their relative displacement; 3. locate the damping connection.
steps.observation: 阻尼器的相對運動與建築的絕對位移不是同一個量。
steps.observationEn: Damper relative motion and building absolute displacement are different quantities.
steps.failure: 擺錘移動很大就表示建築一定失去承載能力。
steps.failureEn: Large pendulum motion necessarily means the building has lost load capacity.
steps.check: 提交兩自由度示意及三種位移定義。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-degree schematic and three displacement definitions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 調諧質量阻尼器是耦合動力系統；它利用相對運動調整主系統反應。
knowledge.textEn: A tuned mass damper is a coupled dynamic system that uses relative motion to modify primary-system response.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 觀景照片只能顯示裝置外形，不能直接給出控制性能或當時荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Observation-deck photos show device appearance, not control performance or concurrent loading.

quiz.question: 審查「畫出調諧質量阻尼器雙系統」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Draw a tuned-mass-damper model”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 阻尼器的相對運動與建築的絕對位移不是同一個量。
擺錘移動很大就表示建築一定失去承載能力。
擺錘的相對位移就是地面量到的建築位移。
optionsEn: Damper relative motion and building absolute displacement are different quantities.
Large pendulum motion necessarily means the building has lost load capacity.
Pendulum relative displacement equals building displacement measured from the ground.
quiz.explanation: 調諧質量阻尼器是耦合動力系統；它利用相對運動調整主系統反應。 觀景照片只能顯示裝置外形，不能直接給出控制性能或當時荷載。
quiz.explanationEn: A tuned mass damper is a coupled dynamic system that uses relative motion to modify primary-system response. Observation-deck photos show device appearance, not control performance or concurrent loading.

steps.title: 理解調諧與離調的差異
steps.titleEn: Understand tuning and detuning
steps.objective: 用比較而非實樓設定值理解頻率匹配。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand frequency matching through comparison rather than real-building settings.
steps.instruction: 1. 建立無量綱兩振子示例；2. 比較接近及偏離主頻率的輔助振子；3. 保持激振條件一致再比較反應曲線。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Create a dimensionless two-oscillator example; 2. compare near-tuned and detuned auxiliary oscillators; 3. hold excitation fixed before comparing responses.
steps.observation: 調諧效果取決於頻率關係與阻尼，不能只看質量大小。
steps.observationEn: Tuning performance depends on frequency relationships and damping, not mass alone.
steps.failure: 阻尼球越重就能在所有頻率下消除全部晃動。
steps.failureEn: A heavier damper ball eliminates all motion at every frequency.
steps.check: 繳交一致激振下的兩條比較曲線與假設。
steps.checkEn: Provide two response comparisons under identical excitation with assumptions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 調諧具有頻率範圍；真實建築存在多模態，單一裝置不是所有反應的萬能解。
knowledge.textEn: Tuning is frequency-dependent; real buildings have multiple modes, so one device is not a universal remedy.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 自設模型只能展示參數敏感度，不能回推原裝置的調整方法。
knowledge.textEn: An invented model illustrates parameter sensitivity and cannot reconstruct adjustment procedures for the actual device.

quiz.question: 審查「理解調諧與離調的差異」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Understand tuning and detuning”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 阻尼球越重就能在所有頻率下消除全部晃動。
調諧效果取決於頻率關係與阻尼，不能只看質量大小。
調諧裝置只影響單一時刻，與激振頻率無關。
optionsEn: A heavier damper ball eliminates all motion at every frequency.
Tuning performance depends on frequency relationships and damping, not mass alone.
A tuned device affects only one instant and is independent of excitation frequency.
quiz.explanation: 調諧具有頻率範圍；真實建築存在多模態，單一裝置不是所有反應的萬能解。 自設模型只能展示參數敏感度，不能回推原裝置的調整方法。
quiz.explanationEn: Tuning is frequency-dependent; real buildings have multiple modes, so one device is not a universal remedy. An invented model illustrates parameter sensitivity and cannot reconstruct adjustment procedures for the actual device.

steps.title: 拆解黏滯耗能與行程邊界
steps.titleEn: Separate viscous dissipation from stroke limits
steps.objective: 理解阻尼與碰撞限制各自的功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate functions of damping and travel limits.
steps.instruction: 1. 在雙振子圖標出相對速度；2. 用概念迴圈畫能量消散；3. 另以虛線標出有限行程而不設定實際數值。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Mark relative velocity in the two-oscillator diagram; 2. sketch a conceptual dissipation loop; 3. mark finite travel separately without actual settings.
steps.observation: 限制行程與消耗振動能量是不同但需協調的功能。
steps.observationEn: Limiting travel and dissipating vibration energy are distinct coordinated functions.
steps.failure: 只要有止擋就不需要分析相對運動及耗能。
steps.failureEn: A stop makes relative-motion and energy-dissipation analysis unnecessary.
steps.check: 提供耗能路徑及行程邊界的分色圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide a color-separated diagram of dissipation and travel boundaries.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 黏滯裝置可把機械能轉為熱；碰撞或止擋會改變系統的非線性反應。
knowledge.textEn: Viscous devices convert mechanical energy to heat; contact or stops change nonlinear system response.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 看見止擋或阻尼器的存在並不等於已驗證其安裝及可用狀態。
knowledge.textEn: The visible presence of stops or dampers does not verify their installation or availability.

quiz.question: 審查「拆解黏滯耗能與行程邊界」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate viscous dissipation from stroke limits”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 只要有止擋就不需要分析相對運動及耗能。
止擋接觸只限制位置，絕不改變系統動態反應。
限制行程與消耗振動能量是不同但需協調的功能。
optionsEn: A stop makes relative-motion and energy-dissipation analysis unnecessary.
Stop contact only limits position and never changes system dynamics.
Limiting travel and dissipating vibration energy are distinct coordinated functions.
quiz.explanation: 黏滯裝置可把機械能轉為熱；碰撞或止擋會改變系統的非線性反應。 看見止擋或阻尼器的存在並不等於已驗證其安裝及可用狀態。
quiz.explanationEn: Viscous devices convert mechanical energy to heat; contact or stops change nonlinear system response. The visible presence of stops or dampers does not verify their installation or availability.

steps.title: 比較位移、速度與加速度
steps.titleEn: Compare displacement, velocity and acceleration
steps.objective: 選擇能回答問題的量測量。
steps.objectiveEn: Select observations that answer the intended question.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫一條平滑概念位移曲線；2. 標出速度與加速度較大的區段；3. 將舒適與間隙問題配到不同觀察量。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a smooth conceptual displacement curve; 2. identify high-speed and high-acceleration portions; 3. map comfort and clearance questions to different observations.
steps.observation: 相同峰值位移的兩段振動可能具有不同峰值加速度。
steps.observationEn: Two motions with equal peak displacement can have different peak accelerations.
steps.failure: 最大位移相同便能保證使用者感受完全相同。
steps.failureEn: Equal maximum displacement guarantees identical occupant experience.
steps.check: 繳交問題、觀察量與量測限制的三欄表。
steps.checkEn: Provide a table of questions, observations and measurement limits.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 對相同振幅的正弦運動，頻率改變會顯著影響加速度；不能只看位移。
knowledge.textEn: For equal-amplitude sinusoidal motion, frequency changes strongly affect acceleration; displacement alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 數值微分會放大量測雜訊，觀察量轉換需要處理誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Numerical differentiation amplifies measurement noise, so converting observations requires error treatment.

quiz.question: 審查「比較位移、速度與加速度」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare displacement, velocity and acceleration”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 相同峰值位移的兩段振動可能具有不同峰值加速度。
最大位移相同便能保證使用者感受完全相同。
將位移曲線微分不會增加量測雜訊影響。
optionsEn: Two motions with equal peak displacement can have different peak accelerations.
Equal maximum displacement guarantees identical occupant experience.
Differentiating displacement never increases the effect of measurement noise.
quiz.explanation: 對相同振幅的正弦運動，頻率改變會顯著影響加速度；不能只看位移。 數值微分會放大量測雜訊，觀察量轉換需要處理誤差。
quiz.explanationEn: For equal-amplitude sinusoidal motion, frequency changes strongly affect acceleration; displacement alone is insufficient. Numerical differentiation amplifies measurement noise, so converting observations requires error treatment.

steps.title: 協調電梯與結構位移
steps.titleEn: Coordinate elevators with structural movement
steps.objective: 理解垂直運輸設備也有結構介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand structural interfaces of vertical transportation.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫電梯井與樓層連接；2. 標出樓層相對移動及設備固定點；3. 分列行車舒適、間隙與維修可達性的問題。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw an elevator shaft and floor connections; 2. mark relative floor movement and fixing points; 3. separate ride comfort, clearance and maintenance-access questions.
steps.observation: 結構能承載仍不代表所有設備介面在移動後保持功能。
steps.observationEn: Structural capacity does not establish continued function of every moving equipment interface.
steps.failure: 電梯速度規格可以取代結構與設備介面的核對。
steps.failureEn: Elevator speed specifications replace structural-equipment interface checks.
steps.check: 提交不含設備調整參數的介面核對清單。
steps.checkEn: Submit an interface checklist without equipment-adjustment settings.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 非結構設備的功能依賴固定方式、間隙及供電等條件，需與結構一起協調。
knowledge.textEn: Equipment function depends on fixings, clearances and power among other conditions, requiring coordination with structure.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 公開高速電梯資料是技術背景，不能用來指導現場調整或維修。
knowledge.textEn: Public high-speed-elevator information provides context, not field-adjustment or maintenance instructions.

quiz.question: 審查「協調電梯與結構位移」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Coordinate elevators with structural movement”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 電梯速度規格可以取代結構與設備介面的核對。
結構能承載仍不代表所有設備介面在移動後保持功能。
電梯和樓層的固定點沒有任何結構作用。
optionsEn: Elevator speed specifications replace structural-equipment interface checks.
Structural capacity does not establish continued function of every moving equipment interface.
Elevator-to-floor fixings have no structural role.
quiz.explanation: 非結構設備的功能依賴固定方式、間隙及供電等條件，需與結構一起協調。 公開高速電梯資料是技術背景，不能用來指導現場調整或維修。
quiz.explanationEn: Equipment function depends on fixings, clearances and power among other conditions, requiring coordination with structure. Public high-speed-elevator information provides context, not field-adjustment or maintenance instructions.

steps.title: 完成風振證據審查
steps.titleEn: Review wind-motion evidence
steps.objective: 區分裝置展示、模型結果與實測證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish device displays, model outputs and measurements.
steps.instruction: 1. 選一張裝置照片與自設曲線；2. 為每項結論標記照片、模型或實測需求；3. 刪除超出現有證據範圍的性能宣稱。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Select a device photo and synthetic response curve; 2. label conclusions as photo-based, model-based or requiring measurement; 3. remove unsupported performance claims.
steps.observation: 模型顯示反應下降仍需實際條件與量測驗證才能推論真樓性能。
steps.observationEn: Reduced model response still needs actual conditions and measurements before inferring real-building performance.
steps.failure: 阻尼球照片足以量出任一次颱風中的減振百分比。
steps.failureEn: A damper-ball photo establishes the vibration-reduction percentage in any typhoon.
steps.check: 提交每項結論均有證據層級的審查表。
steps.checkEn: Submit a review table assigning an evidence level to every conclusion.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 公開展示能解釋裝置用途，但定量驗證需要輸入、感測器、分析方法與誤差。
knowledge.textEn: A public display explains purpose, while quantitative verification needs inputs, sensors, analysis and uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 沒有實測資料時應保留待查項，不能用自設數據填補成真實表現。
knowledge.textEn: Without measurements, retain evidence gaps instead of presenting synthetic data as actual performance.

quiz.question: 審查「完成風振證據審查」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review wind-motion evidence”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 阻尼球照片足以量出任一次颱風中的減振百分比。
從裝置質量可直接推出所有颱風的減振比例。
模型顯示反應下降仍需實際條件與量測驗證才能推論真樓性能。
optionsEn: A damper-ball photo establishes the vibration-reduction percentage in any typhoon.
Device mass directly determines the reduction ratio for every typhoon.
Reduced model response still needs actual conditions and measurements before inferring real-building performance.
quiz.explanation: 公開展示能解釋裝置用途，但定量驗證需要輸入、感測器、分析方法與誤差。 沒有實測資料時應保留待查項，不能用自設數據填補成真實表現。
quiz.explanationEn: A public display explains purpose, while quantitative verification needs inputs, sensors, analysis and uncertainty. Without measurements, retain evidence gaps instead of presenting synthetic data as actual performance.

stages.title: 施工證據與全生命週期
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「施工證據與全生命週期」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on construction evidence and lifecycle, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 拆分施工階段與完成狀態
steps.titleEn: Separate construction and completed states
steps.objective: 辨認逐層建造時尚未形成的系統。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify systems not yet established during staged construction.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫三個不同完成高度；2. 標示各自已連接的核心與周邊部分；3. 對未形成的外伸系統列出概念邊界問題。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch three completion heights; 2. mark connected core and perimeter portions; 3. list boundary questions for incomplete outrigger systems.
steps.observation: 未完成外伸系統時的荷載分配可能不同於竣工模型。
steps.observationEn: Load sharing before outrigger completion may differ from the completed model.
steps.failure: 竣工分析通過即可直接證明所有樓層施工狀態。
steps.failureEn: A completed-state analysis directly verifies every construction stage.
steps.check: 輸出三個狀態的系統有無及證據需求表。
steps.checkEn: Provide a system-presence and evidence table for three states.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 建造順序會改變暫時剛度、荷載與約束，施工狀態需獨立辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Construction sequence changes temporary stiffness, loads and constraints; each state needs identification.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本課程不提供吊裝或臨時支撐方案，只訓練閱讀依賴關係。
knowledge.textEn: This course provides no lifting or temporary-support scheme; it teaches dependency interpretation.

quiz.question: 審查「拆分施工階段與完成狀態」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate construction and completed states”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 未完成外伸系統時的荷載分配可能不同於竣工模型。
竣工分析通過即可直接證明所有樓層施工狀態。
不同完成高度必然具有同一組剛度與約束。
optionsEn: Load sharing before outrigger completion may differ from the completed model.
A completed-state analysis directly verifies every construction stage.
Different completion heights necessarily share identical stiffness and restraints.
quiz.explanation: 建造順序會改變暫時剛度、荷載與約束，施工狀態需獨立辨識。 本課程不提供吊裝或臨時支撐方案，只訓練閱讀依賴關係。
quiz.explanationEn: Construction sequence changes temporary stiffness, loads and constraints; each state needs identification. This course provides no lifting or temporary-support scheme; it teaches dependency interpretation.

steps.title: 追蹤差異縮短與量測基準
steps.titleEn: Track differential shortening and datums
steps.objective: 理解垂直構件並非以相同比例縮短。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why vertical members need not shorten equally.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫核心與周邊柱兩條高度線；2. 加入不同的自設縮短曲線；3. 比較樓層接合及設備介面的相對偏差。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw core and perimeter height lines; 2. add different synthetic shortening curves; 3. compare relative offsets at floor and equipment interfaces.
steps.observation: 共同的總樓高不會消除核心與周邊之間的差異縮短。
steps.observationEn: A common total height does not eliminate differential shortening between core and perimeter.
steps.failure: 把頂樓高度調齊就能保證每層介面都一致。
steps.failureEn: Aligning the roof height guarantees alignment at every floor interface.
steps.check: 提交相對縮短圖並標明時間與基準假設。
steps.checkEn: Provide a relative-shortening plot with time and datum assumptions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 彈性壓縮、材料長期變形與施工加載歷程都可影響垂直變形。
knowledge.textEn: Elastic compression, long-term material behavior and construction loading history can affect vertical deformation.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 需比較同一基準及時間狀態的數據，否則可能把正常歷程誤判成偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Compare data under the same datum and time state to avoid mistaking normal evolution for error.

quiz.question: 審查「追蹤差異縮短與量測基準」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Track differential shortening and datums”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 把頂樓高度調齊就能保證每層介面都一致。
共同的總樓高不會消除核心與周邊之間的差異縮短。
只有最高樓層才會受到垂直縮短影響。
optionsEn: Aligning the roof height guarantees alignment at every floor interface.
A common total height does not eliminate differential shortening between core and perimeter.
Only the top floor is affected by vertical shortening.
quiz.explanation: 彈性壓縮、材料長期變形與施工加載歷程都可影響垂直變形。 需比較同一基準及時間狀態的數據，否則可能把正常歷程誤判成偏差。
quiz.explanationEn: Elastic compression, long-term material behavior and construction loading history can affect vertical deformation. Compare data under the same datum and time state to avoid mistaking normal evolution for error.

steps.title: 檢查帷幕牆與樓層移動相容
steps.titleEn: Review façade and floor-movement compatibility
steps.objective: 辨認非結構外牆與承重骨架的相對位移。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify relative movement between a nonstructural façade and the load-bearing frame.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫跨越兩層的概念帷幕單元；2. 分別加入層間側移與差異縮短；3. 標示接頭、固定點及需查證的空間。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a conceptual façade unit spanning two floors; 2. add story drift and differential shortening separately; 3. mark joints, fixings and clearances requiring evidence.
steps.observation: 結構保持承載功能仍需另外核對外牆接頭的位移相容。
steps.observationEn: Retained structural capacity still requires separate verification of movement compatibility at façade joints.
steps.failure: 樓層位移在結構模型中合理就表示每個外牆接頭都不會受影響。
steps.failureEn: Acceptable floor movements in a structural model guarantee that every façade joint remains unaffected.
steps.check: 提交兩種位移模式與外牆介面的配對圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram matching two movement modes to façade interfaces.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 帷幕牆的固定與接縫需要容納相關移動，非承重不代表沒有工程性能需求。
knowledge.textEn: Façade fixings and joints must accommodate relevant movement; non-load-bearing does not mean free of performance requirements.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本步單元為自繪示意，不代表台北 101 實際外牆固定細節或容許位移。
knowledge.textEn: The teaching unit does not represent Taipei 101’s actual façade fixing details or permissible movements.

quiz.question: 審查「檢查帷幕牆與樓層移動相容」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review façade and floor-movement compatibility”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 樓層位移在結構模型中合理就表示每個外牆接頭都不會受影響。
非承重外牆不需要任何位移相容要求。
結構保持承載功能仍需另外核對外牆接頭的位移相容。
optionsEn: Acceptable floor movements in a structural model guarantee that every façade joint remains unaffected.
A non-load-bearing façade needs no movement-compatibility requirements.
Retained structural capacity still requires separate verification of movement compatibility at façade joints.
quiz.explanation: 帷幕牆的固定與接縫需要容納相關移動，非承重不代表沒有工程性能需求。 本步單元為自繪示意，不代表台北 101 實際外牆固定細節或容許位移。
quiz.explanationEn: Façade fixings and joints must accommodate relevant movement; non-load-bearing does not mean free of performance requirements. The teaching unit does not represent Taipei 101’s actual façade fixing details or permissible movements.

steps.title: 建立結構與營運變更紀錄
steps.titleEn: Create a structural and operational change log
steps.objective: 讓改裝及設備更新留下可追溯介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Preserve traceable interfaces through refits and equipment changes.
steps.instruction: 1. 提出一個假想機械層設備更新；2. 列出質量、振動及維修空間改變；3. 指向必須重新審查的結構與機電資料。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Propose a hypothetical mechanical-floor equipment replacement; 2. list mass, vibration and maintenance-space changes; 3. identify structural and service records needing review.
steps.observation: 用途或設備改變可能影響既有結構假設，即使建築外觀不變。
steps.observationEn: Changes in use or equipment can affect structural assumptions even when the exterior is unchanged.
steps.failure: 室內改裝不改外牆就不必做任何介面審查。
steps.failureEn: An interior refit leaving the façade unchanged needs no interface review.
steps.check: 提交一筆包含原因、影響、版本與待核事項的變更紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Submit a change record with rationale, impacts, versions and open checks.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 全生命週期管理需要保留原假設與變更後條件，才能判斷資料是否仍適用。
knowledge.textEn: Lifecycle management retains original assumptions and changed conditions to judge continued applicability.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 課程假想更新並不表示台北 101 正在進行該項改裝。
knowledge.textEn: The hypothetical replacement does not imply Taipei 101 is undertaking that refit.

quiz.question: 審查「建立結構與營運變更紀錄」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Create a structural and operational change log”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 用途或設備改變可能影響既有結構假設，即使建築外觀不變。
室內改裝不改外牆就不必做任何介面審查。
更新設備重量相同就能省略所有振動和維修介面。
optionsEn: Changes in use or equipment can affect structural assumptions even when the exterior is unchanged.
An interior refit leaving the façade unchanged needs no interface review.
Equal replacement-equipment weight removes every vibration and maintenance interface question.
quiz.explanation: 全生命週期管理需要保留原假設與變更後條件，才能判斷資料是否仍適用。 課程假想更新並不表示台北 101 正在進行該項改裝。
quiz.explanationEn: Lifecycle management retains original assumptions and changed conditions to judge continued applicability. The hypothetical replacement does not imply Taipei 101 is undertaking that refit.

steps.title: 比較其他超高層的抗側系統
steps.titleEn: Compare lateral systems in other towers
steps.objective: 建立台北 101 與其他巨作的可比問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Create comparable questions for Taipei 101 and other landmark towers.
steps.instruction: 1. 選上海中心或哈里發塔作延伸研究；2. 先查其主要結構系統；3. 比較核心、周邊及氣動外形的分工並標示未知。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Select Shanghai Tower or Burj Khalifa for further study; 2. verify its main structural system; 3. compare core, perimeter and aerodynamic-form roles while marking unknowns.
steps.observation: 同為超高層建築不代表阻尼器、核心或外伸系統配置相同。
steps.observationEn: Supertall status does not imply identical damper, core or outrigger layouts.
steps.failure: 外觀都逐層收分就能推定使用同一套抗側系統。
steps.failureEn: Tapered silhouettes establish identical lateral systems.
steps.check: 提交兩項可比問題及至少三項需另查的設計差異。
steps.checkEn: Submit two comparable questions and at least three design differences needing evidence.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 比較先對齊需求與模型邊界，再討論幾何或構件，才能避免用外觀取代機理。
knowledge.textEn: Align requirements and model boundaries before comparing geometry or members to avoid substituting appearance for mechanism.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 延伸項目是下一個資料查證任務；沒有來源支持的細節應明確留白。
knowledge.textEn: The related project begins a new evidence task; leave unsupported details explicitly unknown.

quiz.question: 審查「比較其他超高層的抗側系統」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare lateral systems in other towers”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 外觀都逐層收分就能推定使用同一套抗側系統。
同為超高層建築不代表阻尼器、核心或外伸系統配置相同。
所有超高層都有與台北 101 完全相同的調諧質量阻尼器。
optionsEn: Tapered silhouettes establish identical lateral systems.
Supertall status does not imply identical damper, core or outrigger layouts.
Every supertall has exactly the same tuned mass damper as Taipei 101.
quiz.explanation: 比較先對齊需求與模型邊界，再討論幾何或構件，才能避免用外觀取代機理。 延伸項目是下一個資料查證任務；沒有來源支持的細節應明確留白。
quiz.explanationEn: Align requirements and model boundaries before comparing geometry or members to avoid substituting appearance for mechanism. The related project begins a new evidence task; leave unsupported details explicitly unknown.

steps.title: 審查全生命週期證據包
steps.titleEn: Review the lifecycle evidence pack
steps.objective: 把地標學習轉成可重複使用的工程查證方法。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn landmark study into a reusable engineering-verification method.
steps.instruction: 1. 彙整場址、力路徑、動力及介面圖；2. 為每張圖標記來源與假設；3. 用一個新設備情境測試是否能追到受影響結論。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Assemble site, force, dynamics and interface diagrams; 2. label sources and assumptions; 3. use one new-equipment scenario to trace affected conclusions.
steps.observation: 有版本的圖與假設清單比單一漂亮模型更便於維護與複查。
steps.observationEn: Versioned diagrams and assumption registers support maintenance and review better than one polished model.
steps.failure: 只要動態示意看起來平穩，就能作為真樓性能認證。
steps.failureEn: A stable-looking animation constitutes certification of actual building performance.
steps.check: 提交含未解問題的四階段學習報告。
steps.checkEn: Submit a four-stage learning report including unresolved questions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 高樓工程把結構、機電、使用與維護連在一起，任何一個層面的成功都不能代替整體驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Tall-building engineering connects structure, services, use and maintenance; success in one area does not replace system verification.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 學習報告記錄概念能力與查證方法，不是結構設計或設備維修的執業證明。
knowledge.textEn: The report records conceptual skills and verification methods, not professional authorization for design or equipment maintenance.

quiz.question: 審查「審查全生命週期證據包」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review the lifecycle evidence pack”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 只要動態示意看起來平穩，就能作為真樓性能認證。
結構、設備與使用三者可以完全獨立驗證而忽略交界。
有版本的圖與假設清單比單一漂亮模型更便於維護與複查。
optionsEn: A stable-looking animation constitutes certification of actual building performance.
Structure, equipment and use can be verified independently while ignoring their interfaces.
Versioned diagrams and assumption registers support maintenance and review better than one polished model.
quiz.explanation: 高樓工程把結構、機電、使用與維護連在一起，任何一個層面的成功都不能代替整體驗證。 學習報告記錄概念能力與查證方法，不是結構設計或設備維修的執業證明。
quiz.explanationEn: Tall-building engineering connects structure, services, use and maintenance; success in one area does not replace system verification. The report records conceptual skills and verification methods, not professional authorization for design or equipment maintenance.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「三級風力準則與角隅修形」與「外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping" and "Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「角隅鋸齒缺角」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sawtooth corner notches” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的風工程不是單一設計風速，而是三組回歸期各管一件事：約半年回歸期檢核居住舒適度、50 年回歸期檢核變位、100 年回歸期檢核構材強度。風洞試驗後，建築在四個角隅做出鋸齒狀缺角，讓氣流在角部提早分離並打亂整齊的渦流脫落，使橫風向反應明顯降低。角隅修形同時改變帷幕牆的局部風壓分布，因此構架、阻尼器與外牆三方都必須使用同一份風洞資料，而不是各自套用規範公式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「角隅鋸齒缺角」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's wind engineering is not one design wind speed but three return periods, each governing a different check: roughly a half-year event for occupant comfort, a 50-year event for drift and a 100-year event for member strength. After wind-tunnel testing, the four corners were given sawtooth notches that trigger early flow separation and break up organised vortex shedding, clearly reducing across-wind response. Corner shaping also changes local cladding pressures, so the frame, damper and façade teams must all work from the same wind-tunnel dataset rather than each applying code formulas on their own. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sawtooth corner notches” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以均布等效風壓估計基底彎矩 M = ½·q·C·B·H²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate the base moment from a uniform equivalent pressure, M = ½·q·C·B·H².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「角隅缺角主要是造型裝飾，對結構風力沒有實質影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Corner notches are mainly decorative and have no real effect on structural wind loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「角隅鋸齒缺角」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sawtooth corner notches”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形
knowledge.titleEn: Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping
knowledge.text: 台北 101 的風工程不是單一設計風速，而是三組回歸期各管一件事：約半年回歸期檢核居住舒適度、50 年回歸期檢核變位、100 年回歸期檢核構材強度。風洞試驗後，建築在四個角隅做出鋸齒狀缺角，讓氣流在角部提早分離並打亂整齊的渦流脫落，使橫風向反應明顯降低。
knowledge.textEn: Taipei 101's wind engineering is not one design wind speed but three return periods, each governing a different check: roughly a half-year event for occupant comfort, a 50-year event for drift and a 100-year event for member strength. After wind-tunnel testing, the four corners were given sawtooth notches that trigger early flow separation and break up organised vortex shedding, clearly reducing across-wind response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：角隅缺角主要是造型裝飾，對結構風力沒有實質影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Corner notches are mainly decorative and have no real effect on structural wind loads. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「角隅鋸齒缺角」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sawtooth corner notches” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以均布等效風壓估計基底彎矩 M = ½·q·C·B·H²。取 q = 2.5 kPa、C = 1.3、B = 50 m、H = 500 m，M = 0.5×2,500×1.3×50×500² ≈ 20.3 GN·m；若角隅修形使等效係數降低 25%，M 約降為 15.2 GN·m，基礎與巨柱軸力隨之同比例減少。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate the base moment from a uniform equivalent pressure, M = ½·q·C·B·H². With q = 2.5 kPa, C = 1.3, B = 50 m and H = 500 m, M = 0.5×2,500×1.3×50×500² ≈ 20.3 GN·m; if corner shaping lowers the equivalent coefficient by 25%, M falls to about 15.2 GN·m and foundation and mega-column forces drop in proportion. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：要求風洞報告分別列出三種回歸期的基底彎矩、變位與頂層加速度，並附角隅修形與未修形的比較試驗；高頻力平衡結果要以結構實際模態重新組合，再與規範公式估算比對，差異超過約兩成時必須查明原因並書面說明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Require the wind-tunnel report to list base moments, drifts and top-floor accelerations separately for the three return periods, with comparative tests of notched and unnotched corners; recombine force-balance results with the structure's actual modes, compare with code-formula estimates, and investigate and document any difference larger than about 20%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「角隅鋸齒缺角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sawtooth corner notches” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 要求風洞報告分別列出三種回歸期的基底彎矩、變位與頂層加速度，並附角隅修形與未修形的比較試驗；高頻力平衡結果要以結構實際模態重新組合，再與規範公式估算比對，差異超過約兩成時必須查明原因並書面說明。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Require the wind-tunnel report to list base moments, drifts and top-floor accelerations separately for the three return periods, with comparative tests of notched and unnotched corners; recombine force-balance results with the structure's actual modes, compare with code-formula estimates, and investigate and document any difference larger than about 20%. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把三級風力準則與允收值寫入結構設計基準書，任何外形變更（角隅尺寸、塔頂與帷幕牆突出物）都必須回送風工程顧問評估，並在變更紀錄中保留風洞比對資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write the three-tier wind criteria and acceptance values into the structural design basis, send any change of external form (corner dimensions, crown, façade projections) back to the wind consultant for assessment, and keep the wind-tunnel comparison in the change record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只拿 100 年強度風載設計構架而未檢核半年回歸期加速度，結構雖安全，常見颱風時高樓層使用者仍會明顯不適；若角隅缺角在施工中為了帷幕牆單元化而被簡化，實際風力可能回到未修形的較高水準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing the frame only for 100-year strength loads without checking half-year accelerations leaves a safe structure that still makes upper-floor occupants uncomfortable in common typhoons; if the corner notches are simplified during construction to ease unitised cladding, actual wind forces can revert to the higher unnotched level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sawtooth corner notches” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只拿 100 年強度風載設計構架而未檢核半年回歸期加速度，結構雖安全，常見颱風時高樓層使用者仍會明顯不適；若角隅缺角在施工中為了帷幕牆單元化而被簡化，實際風力可能回到未修形的較高水準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Corner shaping also changes local cladding pressures, so the frame, damper and façade teams must all work from the same wind-tunnel dataset rather than each applying code formulas on their own.

steps.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「八支巨柱的力偶」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eight-mega-column couple” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 周邊有八支巨柱（每面兩支），26 樓以下每面另有次巨柱與角柱經帶狀桁架加入；外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，依位置做成單層、雙層或三層高。核心筒受風彎曲時，外伸桁架像槓桿一樣把核心的轉角變成巨柱軸力：一側減壓、另一側增壓，形成力偶抵抗大部分傾覆彎矩。因為巨柱本身已承受很大的重力壓力，風或地震造成的軸力變化多半只是減少壓力，但柱續接仍須檢核少量的淨上拉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「八支巨柱的力偶」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101 has eight perimeter mega-columns, two per face; below level 26, sub-super columns and corner columns on each face are engaged through belt trusses. Outriggers occur about every 8 to 10 floors and are one, two or three storeys deep depending on location. When the core bends in wind, the outriggers act as levers that turn core rotation into mega-column axial force, unloading one side and adding compression to the other, so a couple resists most of the overturning moment. Because the mega-columns already carry heavy gravity compression, wind or seismic axial changes mostly reduce compression, yet column splices must still be checked for small net uplift. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Eight-mega-column couple” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n).

steps.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「八支巨柱的力偶」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eight-mega-column couple” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。若外伸桁架交給巨柱的彎矩 M_col = 12 GN·m，受拉側與受壓側巨柱群形心距 a = 40 m、每側 n = 4 支，ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN；重力軸力若為 350 MN，風作用時兩側分別為 275 MN 與 425 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n). If the outriggers deliver M_col = 12 GN·m to the columns, with a = 40 m between tension-side and compression-side group centroids and n = 4 columns per side, ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN; with 350 MN of gravity load, the two sides carry 275 MN and 425 MN under wind. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較；再以手算力偶核對各道外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿力，確認每一道外伸桁架的分擔比例與其勁度排序一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output from the three-dimensional model the share of overturning carried by the core and by the mega-columns, and compare top drift with a core-only model; then check the chord and diagonal forces in each outrigger level with a hand couple calculation, confirming that each level's share matches its stiffness ranking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「八支巨柱的力偶」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eight-mega-column couple” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較；再以手算力偶核對各道外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿力，確認每一道外伸桁架的分擔比例與其勁度排序一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output from the three-dimensional model the share of overturning carried by the core and by the mega-columns, and compare top drift with a core-only model; then check the chord and diagonal forces in each outrigger level with a hand couple calculation, confirming that each level's share matches its stiffness ranking. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在設計書中列出每一道外伸桁架的樓層、深度、所連接的巨柱與分擔比例，柱續接處標明最大淨上拉的載重組合，並要求鋼構製造圖保留這些標記以便現場查核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: List in the design report each outrigger's level, depth, connected mega-columns and share of overturning, mark the governing net-uplift load combination at column splices, and require shop drawings to carry these marks for site checking.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending; conversely, locking the joints too early without allowing for differential shortening imposes additional gravity-induced forces on columns and outriggers after completion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為巨柱本身已承受很大的重力壓力，風或地震造成的軸力變化多半只是減少壓力，但柱續接仍須檢核少量的淨上拉。

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部

steps.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的巨柱底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，由厚 50 至 80 mm 的鋼板焊成箱形，內灌設計強度約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）的高強度混凝土，並以內部繫材防止鋼板外鼓。鋼箱提供模板、圍束與抗拉能力，混凝土提供大部分軸壓勁度並阻止鋼板向內挫屈，兩者合作的效率高於各自單獨使用。斷面隨高度逐段縮小，填充高度也分段結束（核心箱形柱與巨柱填至約 62 層），每一段的合成比例不同，計算必須逐段進行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's mega-columns are about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, welded into boxes from 50 to 80 mm plates and filled with high-strength concrete of about 10,000 psi (about 69 MPa) design strength, with internal ties preventing the plates from bulging. The steel box provides formwork, confinement and tension capacity, while the concrete supplies most of the axial stiffness and stops the plates buckling inwards, so together they outperform either material alone. The section shrinks with height and the fill stops at different levels (core box columns and super columns are filled to about level 62), so the composite proportions change and must be checked segment by segment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量
knowledge.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity
knowledge.text: 台北 101 的巨柱底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，由厚 50 至 80 mm 的鋼板焊成箱形，內灌設計強度約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）的高強度混凝土，並以內部繫材防止鋼板外鼓。鋼箱提供模板、圍束與抗拉能力，混凝土提供大部分軸壓勁度並阻止鋼板向內挫屈，兩者合作的效率高於各自單獨使用。

The steel box provides formwork, confinement and tension capacity, while the concrete supplies most of the axial stiffness and stops the plates buckling inwards, so together they outperform either material alone.

steps.observation: 如何核對：逐段建立巨柱斷面表（外尺寸、板厚、填充起訖樓層、混凝土強度），以合成柱公式與有限元素斷面分析互相核對；確認重力加風或地震組合下的軸力比在允許範圍，並檢查柱續接與隔板位置與製造圖一致。

steps.title: 高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SM570M thick plates and column splices” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的主要鋼構使用 SM570M 等級鋼材，降伏強度約 60 ksi 以上，板厚可達 80 mm。厚板焊接時冷卻快、拘束大，容易產生氫致裂紋與層狀撕裂，因此規格同時限制碳當量（板厚 40 mm 以下約 0.44%、40 mm 以上約 0.47%）與降伏比（較厚的梁與斜撐約 80%、較薄者約 85%），確保焊接性與塑性變形能力。柱續接採全滲透焊，以抵抗風與地震下可能出現的少量淨上拉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's main steelwork uses SM570M steel with a yield strength of about 60 ksi or more and plates up to 80 mm thick. Column splices are full-penetration welds to resist the small net uplift that wind and earthquakes can produce. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：岩盤段側摩擦 Q = π·D·L·f_s。取 D = 1.5 m、嵌入長 L = 20 m、單位側摩擦 f_s = 0.30 MPa，Q = π×1.5×20×0.30 ≈ 28.3 MN，安全係數 2 時容許約 14.1 MN。樁距 3.96/1.5 ≈ 2.6 倍樁徑，群樁效應會增加沉陷。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Rock-socket side resistance Q = π·D·L·f_s. The spacing of 3.96/1.5 ≈ 2.6 diameters means group effects increase settlement. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Load-test trial piles statically; the published paper records compression tests up to about 40.6 MN and pull-out tests up to about 22 MN, plus proof tests on production piles in the tower area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塑性轉角 θ_p ≈ θ_total − θ_y。若層間變位角 1/90 = 0.0111 rad、梁降伏轉角 0.0060 rad，θ_p ≈ 0.0051 rad，超過 0.005 rad 門檻，需改用減弱斷面；雙重系統下若總基底剪力 V = 100 MN，抗彎構架單獨須能承擔 0.25×100 = 25 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.observation: 如何核對：以多組符合場址條件的地震紀錄做非線性時間歷程分析，逐層輸出層間變位角與梁端塑性轉角分布，並與兩級性能目標比對；再把核心斜撐移除、只留抗彎構架做一次分析，確認 25% 的獨立承載要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several site-appropriate records, output storey drift angles and beam-end plastic rotations floor by floor and compare them with the two performance targets; then analyse the moment frame alone with the core bracing removed to confirm the independent 25% requirement, and support reduced-section cut dimensions with full-scale or published test data.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：擺錘簡諧運動的最大速度 v = 2π·f·A。取 f = 0.14 Hz、A = 1.0 m，v = 2π×0.14×1.0 ≈ 0.88 m/s，660 t 擺錘的動能 ½·m·v² ≈ 0.5×660,000×0.88² ≈ 256 kJ；若設計行程為 ±1.5 m，行程使用率約 1.0/1.5 ≈ 67%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：事件後先調出擺錘位移、樓層加速度與風速或地震紀錄，確認最大擺幅與行程限制之間的餘裕；接著目視檢查緩衝環接觸痕跡、阻尼器漏油、吊索與吊點，必要時以自由擺動量測頻率是否仍與基準值相符，結果寫入事件報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an event, retrieve pendulum displacement, floor acceleration and wind or earthquake records and confirm the margin between peak swing and stroke limits; then inspect bumper-ring contact marks, damper leaks, hangers and pick points, and if needed measure the free-swing frequency against the baseline, recording the results in an event report.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：四邊簡支玻璃板最大應力 σ = β·p·a²/t²。短邊 a = 1.5 m、厚 t = 12 mm、風壓 p = 4.0 kPa、β = 0.48，σ = 0.48×4,000×1.5²/0.012² = 30 MPa；層間變位角 1/200、樓高 4.2 m 時，框架水平錯動 4,200/200 = 21 mm，需由框內間隙與滑動連接吸收。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實尺寸帷幕牆試體做風壓（含颱風循環）、水密、氣密與層間變位試驗，確認玻璃不破、密封不漏水；完工後定期以目視與望遠鏡檢查密封膠劣化與玻璃自爆，並記錄每片更換玻璃的位置、原因與規格。

quiz.question: 要驗證「颱風風壓下的帷幕玻璃與長期維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Curtain-wall glass under typhoon pressure and long-term upkeep"?
options: 以實尺寸帷幕牆試體做風壓（含颱風循環）、水密、氣密與層間變位試驗，確認玻璃不破、密封不漏水。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。
optionsEn: Test full-scale curtain-wall mock-ups for wind pressure including typhoon cycles, water and air tightness and storey-drift racking, confirming no glass breakage or leakage.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed.
quiz.explanation: 以實尺寸帷幕牆試體做風壓（含颱風循環）、水密、氣密與層間變位試驗，確認玻璃不破、密封不漏水；完工後定期以目視與望遠鏡檢查密封膠劣化與玻璃自爆，並記錄每片更換玻璃的位置、原因與規格。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test full-scale curtain-wall mock-ups for wind pressure including typhoon cycles, water and air tightness and storey-drift racking, confirming no glass breakage or leakage; after completion inspect visually and with binoculars for sealant ageing and spontaneous glass breakage, recording the location, cause and specification of every replaced pane. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 颱風風壓下的帷幕玻璃與長期維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Curtain-wall glass under typhoon pressure and long-term upkeep: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「帷幕牆玻璃與層間變位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Curtain-wall glass and storey drift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若帷幕牆連接件在安裝時被誤鎖死，層間變位會直接擠壓玻璃，造成角部破裂；颱風期間一片玻璃破損會讓室內受壓，進而吹落隔間與天花板，碎片也成為高空墜落物。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If curtain-wall connections are mistakenly locked during installation, storey drift squeezes the glass directly and cracks the corners; one broken pane in a typhoon pressurises the interior, blowing out partitions and ceilings and turning fragments into falling debris. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長期維護的重點是密封膠、墊片、破損玻璃更換，以及外牆維護設備的可達性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Long-term upkeep centres on sealants, gaskets, broken-glass replacement and access for façade maintenance equipment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆只是外觀，不需要配合結構的變位來設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A curtain wall is cosmetic and need not be designed for structural movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 巨柱檢核練習：某鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱 2.4 m × 3.0 m、板厚 80 mm，f_y = 414 MPa、f_c = 69 MPa。A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m²、A_s = 0.84 m²，名目擠壓強度 N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 720 MN，取強度折減 0.75 得設計容量約 540 MN。外伸桁架傳來的彎矩 12 GN·m 由力臂 40 m、每側 4 支巨柱分擔，ΔN = 12,000/(40×4) = 75 MN；重力軸力 350 MN 時受壓側合計 425 MN，使用率 425/540 ≈ 0.79。若填充混凝土只達 41 MPa，N₀ 約 569 MN、設計容量約 427 MN，使用率升到約 1.00，已無餘裕；若外伸桁架勁度不足使 M_col 降為 8 GN·m，ΔN 減為 50 MN，但核心筒須多承擔 4 GN·m。數值為教學假設，不代表台北 101 的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Mega-column check: a concrete-filled steel box 2.4 m × 3.0 m with 80 mm plate, f_y = 414 MPa and f_c = 69 MPa. A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m² and A_s = 0.84 m², so the nominal squash load is N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 720 MN, or about 540 MN design capacity with a resistance factor of 0.75. An outrigger moment of 12 GN·m shared over a 40 m lever arm by 4 columns per side gives ΔN = 12,000/(40×4) = 75 MN; with 350 MN of gravity load the compression side carries 425 MN, a utilisation of 425/540 ≈ 0.79. If the infill reaches only 41 MPa, N₀ is about 569 MN and design capacity about 427 MN, pushing utilisation to about 1.00 with no margin left; if softer outriggers reduce M_col to 8 GN·m, ΔN drops to 50 MN but the core must carry an extra 4 GN·m. Values are teaching assumptions, not Taipei 101's design values.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.
